svg.title: Welcome to my GitHub. Hi, I'm Nitin Govardhane, a full-stack engineer.
svg.desc: Animated banner: an intro in the style of nitingovardhane.com above a scene of Nitin in a hoodie typing code on a multi-monitor desk at night while it rains outside, with a cat roaming the desk and an owl perched on the window.
